name: @profullstack/redeem-credits
description: Redeemable credit codes for every Profullstack site: mint a scarce code, redeem it for one-off or monthly credits, spend against the balance. Codes stored only as sha256 hashes; memory, SQLite (bun:sqlite, node:sqlite, better-sqlite3) and Postgres stores; redeem-credits CLI.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
